project_type: ACIP — Python uv-workspace monorepo (libs/* + 14 services/* FastAPI services) over open-source infra (Redpanda/Kafka, Neo4j, Postgres, Redis, Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger) in Docker Compose. Phase 4 adds a self-contained React/Node SPA in ui/ (NOT a uv member) plus a host-process local run mode.
language: Python 3.11+ for backend/services; TypeScript + React 18 for the new ui/ frontend.
build_system: Backend: uv workspace (root pyproject.toml members=['libs/*','services/*']; each service a member built via its Dockerfile with repo-root context and `uv sync --frozen --no-dev --package <name>`). Frontend: npm + Vite (ui/ is self-contained, own package.json + committed package-lock.json, NOT added to uv). QUIRK: service container port is hardcoded in each Dockerfile CMD `uvicorn <pkg>.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000`; local mode overrides only via the uvicorn --port CLI arg (no Settings/Dockerfile/compose change).
test_framework: Backend: pytest (run via `uv run pytest ...`), 127 passing pre-Phase-4. Frontend: Vitest + React Testing Library + jsdom (run via `npm run test` -> `vitest run`).
build_command: Backend: `uv sync`. Frontend: `cd ui && npm ci && npm run build` (tsc -b && vite build). Docker UI image also runs npm ci && npm run build in its node:20-alpine stage.
test_command: Backend static gate: `uv run ruff check .` && `uv run black --check .` && `uv run mypy libs services` && `uv run pytest libs/acip-common libs/acip-agent-common services`. Frontend: `cd ui && npm run lint && npm run test`.
verification_instructions: 1) Backend static gate (ruff/black/mypy/pytest) from repo root — expect prior 127 tests + the new CORS test passing. 2) Frontend gate in ui/: `npm ci`, `npm run build` (produces ui/dist), `npm run lint`, `npm run test`. If host Node unavailable, the npm ci && npm run build is exercised by `docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml build demo-ui`; state the substitution. 3) `docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml config` valid and lists demo-ui at 8090:80 with every other service byte-identical (git diff of compose shows only the added block). 4) DOCKER mode: `./start.sh` -> full stack up, seeded, five-scenario demo passes (clean_shopper->APPROVE, ring_member->DECLINE, high_value_midrisk->CHALLENGE, sanctioned_geo->DECLINE, unhealthy_preferred_route->APPROVE on alternate); Demo UI at http://localhost:8090. 5) LOCAL mode: `make up-local` (or ./start-local.sh) -> infra in Docker, 14 app services as host uvicorn processes, React UI via Vite dev server; scripts/demo.py passes vs http://localhost:8080; UI at http://localhost:5173; `./stop-local.sh` stops host processes, default leaves infra up.
snapshot_or_generated_files: ui/package-lock.json MUST be generated (npm install once) and COMMITTED. ML artifacts under ml/models (model_card.json etc.) are produced by `make train` and are gitignored. ui/dist and ui/node_modules are build outputs and MUST be gitignored. No other checked-in generated files.
environment_constraints: node/npm are NOT installed on this host (verified: `node`/`npm` -> not found); docker IS installed (/usr/local/bin/docker). Therefore: the React Docker image build is self-contained (node:20-alpine stage) and works with no host Node; host-side frontend steps (npm ci/build/lint, vitest, the local-mode Vite dev server on 5173) REQUIRE installing Node 20 on the host first. start-local.sh must detect missing node/npm and fail with a clear install message. If Node cannot be installed, run the frontend gate via `docker compose build demo-ui` and document that the live Vite-dev-server local step was skipped. Never restart/clash with the Docker stack while running local mode (local ports differ: app services 8081-8086/8091-8097, UI 5173; Docker UI 8090). Stay on branch feat/phase1-foundation; never branch/reset/rebase/amend/force-push; never push.
contribution_requirements: Only the additive CORSMiddleware on checkout-api is a permitted backend code change — it must not alter decision behavior. Everything else is additive: do NOT modify existing compose service blocks, start.sh behavior (only extend its printed summary), .env.example, or docs/01-07 (DEMO-WALKTHROUGH.md + README.md MAY be updated). ui/ is NOT a uv workspace member — do NOT add it to root pyproject.toml [tool.uv.sources] or [dependency-groups]. Git: stage only source files; NEVER commit .env, .env.local, logs/, run/, ui/node_modules/, ui/dist/, ml/data, ml/models, or .agents/tasks bookkeeping. Commit with `git commit -F <msgfile>` or a single short `-m` one-liner; never a multi-line inline message.
key_patterns: checkout-api is the ONLY public service (Docker host 8080:8000). POST /v1/checkout response (from _public_decision in services/checkout-api/src/checkout_api/main.py) = {transaction_id, decision, route, composite_score, explanation, recommended_method, partial, degraded_agents, route_alternatives, verdicts:{} (ALWAYS empty), trace_id}. The six per-agent verdicts live only in GET /v1/transactions/{id} (reads._transaction_view -> verdicts:[{agent,score,hint}]) and GET /v1/transactions/{id}/explain (reads._explain_view -> {transaction_id, inputs:{customer_id,amount}, verdicts:[...], strategy, final_decision:{decision,composite_score,status}}); a never-seeded/unknown id returns 404, and verdicts may be empty/partial right after POST (agents still committing) so the UI must POST then poll GET /v1/transactions/{id} a few times and tolerate empty. Decision banner colors: APPROVE=green, CHALLENGE=amber, DECLINE=red. Scenario bodies mirror scripts/demo.py._request_body + scripts/seed.py.SCENARIOS: merchant_id='mrc_demo', currency='INR', context.device_fingerprint=<device_id>, context.ip='203.0.113.9', context.user_agent='acip-demo/1.0', idempotency_key='idem_demo_<name>', payment_method.token='tok_<name>'. Five scenarios: clean_shopper(cus_clean,120.0,upi,dev_clean->APPROVE), ring_member(cus_ring,90.0,card,dev_shared->DECLINE), high_value_midrisk(cus_midrisk,4800.0,card,dev_midrisk->CHALLENGE), sanctioned_geo(cus_sanctioned,200.0,wallet,dev_sanctioned->DECLINE), unhealthy_preferred_route(cus_reroute,260.0,card,dev_reroute->APPROVE on alternate route). All 14 services launch via `uvicorn <module>.main:app` (agents+graph-projector expose a health FastAPI app whose lifespan starts the Kafka consumer). Module names: checkout_api, commerce_orchestrator, representation_service, ml_scoring_service, llm_gateway, decision_engine, payment_processor_sim, risk_agent, fraud_agent, routing_agent, policy_agent, merchant_agent, checkout_personalization_agent, graph_projector. Redpanda already advertises OUTSIDE://localhost:19092 and publishes 19092:19092 (no compose edit for local Kafka). start.sh has a reusable wait_for_container_health helper and host DSN pattern (POSTGRES_DSN=postgresql://acip:acip@localhost:5432/acip, NEO4J_URI=bolt://localhost:7687, REDIS_URL=redis://redis... localhost:6379). Config via acip_common.config.Settings (env-driven, pydantic-settings).

services/checkout-api/tests/test_checkout.py (test pattern; add CORS test here or new tests/test_cors.py)

directory_structure: Repo root: pyproject.toml (uv workspace root), Makefile, start.sh/stop.sh, .env.example, .gitignore, README.md. libs/ (acip-common, acip-agent-common). services/ (14 FastAPI services, each src/<module>/main.py + Dockerfile + pyproject.toml + tests/). scripts/ (seed.py, demo.py). deploy/ (docker-compose.yml, prometheus/, grafana/). ml/ (training + gitignored data/models). docs/ (00-07 LOCKED + DEMO-WALKTHROUGH.md editable). .agents/tasks/ (bookkeeping, gitignored from commits). NEW in Phase 4: top-level ui/ (React SPA: package.json, package-lock.json, tsconfig*, vite.config.ts, index.html, src/{main.tsx,App.tsx,api/,components/,scenarios.ts,decision.ts,styles.css,__tests__/}, Dockerfile, nginx.conf, .dockerignore, .gitignore, README.md); .env.local.example, start-local.sh, stop-local.sh at repo root; logs/ + run/ (gitignored runtime dirs).
